system.description:
Drawing on his unholy connection to the beasts of the wilds, the Fiend drains the blood of a ferocious animal — a wolf, bear, boar, or similar creature. Immediately after the draining, a metamorphosis occurs: the Tzimisce takes on features of the slain beast, becoming a hybrid monster. Fiends often combine this power with shapeshifting Vicissitude arts, especially when making war on Lupines.

System: Costs two Blood Traits and requires Vicissitude (3) to use. The Tzimisce drains an animal completely dry, then over the next several minutes sprouts fur, tusks, claws, horns, or other weaponry appropriate to the creature killed. Generally the Fiend gains a bonus to soak, claws that inflict aggravated damage, and a bite that inflicts aggravated damage, but all Social Traits drop to zero for the duration.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
system.duration: Several minutes to onset; lasts until the Fiend releases the form
